label: Check Point Quantum 6200 security gateway
description: 1RU gateway: 8x 1G RJ45 data + 1G mgmt + 1G sync, 1 empty expansion slot, 9 Gbps FW.
notes: Datasheet August 2023. Base model 10 GbE copper total = 8x '10/100/1000 Base-T ports' + 'Management 10/100/1000 Base-T port' + 'Sync 10/100/1000 Base-T port'; 1 network expansion slot empty as shipped; RJ45 + USB-C console; 2x USB 3.0. Plus package adds 4x 1GbE fibre, redundant PSU, LOM, 16 GB RAM; max capacity 18 copper + 4 fibre + 4x 10GbE. Optional modules deliberately not modelled as present.

label: SonicWall TZ470 firewall
description: Desktop Gen 7 NGFW: X0 LAN/MGMT, X1-X2 WAN, X3-X7 RJ45 (8x 1G), X8/X9 SFP/SFP+ at 2.5/5/10G, 2.5 Gbps threat prevention.
notes: TZ Series (Gen 7) datasheet header: '8x1GbE, 2x2.5/5/10GbE'. Rear-panel diagram confirms X3-X7 as RJ45 and X8/X9 as 'SFP/SFP+ Ports'. TZ470W adds 802.11ac Wave 2 radios (the W variant), not modelled here. Optional second PSU; 1.5M max connections; storage expandable to 256 GB.

label: WatchGuard Firebox M390 firewall
description: 1RU UTM: 8x 1G RJ45, RJ45 RS232 console, single 150 W PSU, no SFP.
notes: Hardware guide interface table: M390 network interfaces '8 x 1000 Base-TX (10/100/1000Mbps) RJ45 connector'; I/O '2 x USB 3.0, 1 x RJ45 RS232 console'. Family split documented: M290 same ports but 4 GB RAM and 65 W PSU; M590 adds 2x 10G SFP+; M690 adds 2x 10G SFP+ plus 2x 10/2.5/10G RJ45.

label: WatchGuard Firebox M690 firewall
description: 1RU UTM: 8x 1G RJ45 + 2x 10G SFP+ + 2x 10/2.5/1G RJ45, dual PSU.
notes: Hardware guide: M690 '8 x 1000 Base-TX (10/100/1000Mbps) RJ45 connector, 2 x 10G SFP+ interfaces, 2 x 10GbE (1000/2500/10000 Mbps) RJ45 Connector'. The multi-gig copper ladder 1000/2500/10000 is stated explicitly, so the two 10GbE RJ45 ports carry speedCaps [1000, 2500, 10000]. NXP LX2160A, 512 GB m.2, 16 GB ECC, dual 150 W PSUs.

label: Barracuda CloudGen Firewall F80 (NOT CATALOGUED)
notes: OPEN: the F-series datasheet found is feature-oriented (security stack, SD-WAN, protocol support) and never states a per-model port count - the port matrix lives in the hardware documentation, not the datasheet. Not catalogued rather than guessed; needs the F80 hardware guide or the model-specific spec sheet.

label: SonicWall TZ570 (NOT CATALOGUED THIS ROUND)
notes: Front/rear panel diagrams for the TZ570 are in the same PDF (X0-X7 RJ45, X8/X9 SFP/SFP+), but the port line for that model was not extracted cleanly enough to be certain about its 5G versus 10G cage rating.
